title: Errors appear in debugger when custom user directory is set to a path with a trailing `/`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable, 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7247) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-9100F CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads)

### Issue description

When `application/config/use_custom_user_dir` is true and `application/config/custom_user_dir_name` is set to a path ending with "/", Godot gives error(s):
- 4.3:
- - E 0:00:00:0585   RendererCompositorRD: Can't create shader cache folder, no shader caching will happen: user://
  <C++ Source>   servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_compositor_rd.cpp:272 @ RendererCompositorRD()
- 4.4.1:
- - E 0:00:00:612   RendererCompositorRD: Can't create shader cache folder, no shader caching will happen: user://
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_compositor_rd.cpp:279 @ RendererCompositorRD()
- - E 0:00:03:425   _save_to_cache: Condition "f.is_null()" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shader_rd.cpp:512 @ _save_to_cache()

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a project.
2. Open Project settings and set `application/config/use_custom_user_dir` to true and `application/config/custom_user_dir_name` to folder name with ending "/" (e.g. `application/config/custom_user_dir_name`="MyCoolGame/").
3. Run the project (any scene) and check the Debugger.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[github-issue-mrp-custom-user-dir-error-4.4.1.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20024897/github-issue-mrp-custom-user-dir-error-4.4.1.zip)
